narrative.title: The Commission-Loaded Exchange
narrative.scenario: The broker's exchange now levies a flat commission on every completed cycle, regardless of its size. Trades stay unlimited, but each lock-release pair pays the toll once. Dispatch must skip marginal swings whose spread cannot clear the commission and focus on cycles that genuinely pay.
narrative.inputFormat: An array prices where prices[i] is the fee on hour i, and an integer fee charged per completed transaction.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum total profit with unlimited transactions after paying fee once per buy-sell pair.

hintLevels: Level 1: The commission lands exactly once per cycle, so attach it to the sell action.
Level 2: In the hold/skip machine, the sell branch contributes prices[i] - fee instead of prices[i].
Level 3: A cycle is only worth opening when some future sell clears price + fee; the DP discovers this automatically.
